# Runtime notices

The cross-compiled development DLL and ABI test executable link GCC runtime libraries and MinGW-w64 support code statically. Their Debian-supplied copyright/license notices are retained here, including the GCC Runtime Library Exception in `gcc-runtime-notices.txt`. The GNU license texts referenced by the notices are included alongside them.

These notices do not license HellBoost's own code or grant rights to Valve/NextClient game files. No Valve or NextClient source or binaries are included in this repository's development archives. MSVC builds use their own toolchain runtimes rather than these GCC runtimes.

The independent native browser uses nlohmann/json 3.11.3 under MIT. Its original header and license are in `nlohmann/`; it is not connected to a game-client implementation.
